Cloud decides whether to accept user uploads through its signed telemetry collector. Rejected uploads return an actionable storage error; screenshots and artifacts continue. Self-hosted gateways do not enforce a Cloud plan allowance.

Linux gateways running as root can start Chromium and reopen it from the desktop panel. Chromium's internal sandbox remains enabled for non-root users. Gateway protocol 90 and framework 0.16.9 are unchanged.
